Definition: properly, to stretch; by implication, to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively, to be extended
BiblicalUsage: 1) to measure, stretch; 1a) (Qal) to measure; 1b) (Niphal) to be measured; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to extend, continue; 1c2) to measure, measure off; 1d) (Po) measured; 1e) (Hithpolel) to extend oneself, stretch oneself
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
